subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】taller 更高的; shorter 更矮的; longer 更长的; thinner 更瘦的; heavier 更重的; bigger 更大的; smaller 更小的; stronger 更强壮的; than 比
【重点句型】How tall are you? 你多高？ I'm ... metres. 我……米。 Who is taller? 谁更高？ ... is ...er than ... ……比……更…… You're heavier than me. 你比我重。
【A Let's talk】Zhang Peng: How tall are you? Mike: I'm 1.61 metres. Zhang Peng: Oh, I'm 1.65 metres. I'm taller than you. Mike: Yes, you're taller. You're stronger, too.
【Read and write】I am taller than before. Last year I was 1.50 metres. Now I am 1.55 metres. My brother is 1.60 metres. He is taller than me. But I am thinner than him. My feet are smaller than his. We are both growing.
key_points: How tall are you? 你多高？
You're heavier than me. 你比我重。
cautions: 只做内容骨架（核心词汇、重点句型、对话与短文范例），不生成老师逐字讲解稿；词汇与句型均依据该 PEP 单元目标语言整理，不得编造教材未出现的单词、语法点或例句。
